fn sum(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else (n + sum((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (sum(0) == 0)
  example (sum(1) == 1)
